caption:
"Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good."

Qur'an 16:128 (Surah An-Nahl). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 16:128, Surah An-Nahl. Checked against the no-repeat ledger (scripts/_bd_dupcheck.mjs): NEW. 8-language/10-slide format.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, live call https://api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/16:128/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-11-05); fetched twice in the same script and diffed identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields.
sourcing.other_editions: en.sahih (Saheeh International), zh.jian (Ma Jian), ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), es.cortes (Julio Cortes): same call. ko.korean and ja.japanese: translator listed as unknown by source; slides say 'Translator not specified by source'.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Artifact scan (double spaces, space before punctuation, trim, control chars) clean. Korean edition 16:128 had a missing space ('이들과함께하시니라'); fixed by a spacing-only replacement to '이들과 함께하시니라' on the slide; no wording changed.
